rotation.basis: day-of-year 285 (2026-10-12), day-of-month 12; pool size 34. Yesterday (doy 284) emphasized pool indices 12-27; a +1 shift would repeat nearly the same slice, so today emphasizes the complementary half: indices 28-33 then wrapping 0-10 (17 keywords).
rotation.method: Unattended-run override: working set = ALL 3 core + ENTIRE 34-keyword medicine pool (37 total). Rotation only sets EMPHASIS / naming order: today's 17 emphasized keywords get dedicated queries and are named first; the other 17 (yesterday's specialty slice + prior auth) are merged into shared multi-keyword queries. Expansions shifted vs 2026-10-11 toward new sub-angles (mammography/stroke CT instead of prostate/lung/spine, non-cervical pathology, Epic/Oracle agents instead of Abridge/Suki, Korean regulator and export news). No WebSearch used in planning.
rotation.notes: Scope per sources.json medicine _note: clinical/treatment only (trials, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/CE, hospital deployment, diagnosis/imaging, disease-specific drug discovery, SaMD, EHR/documentation, telehealth, prior auth, patient safety/bias/liability). Disease-unspecified biology/protein-structure models belong to science - drop unless a named disease/patient/clinician is reached; never put one story in both sections. Exclude funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, wellness-app promos. SAFETY: never pick pathogen gain-of-function / bioweapon-readable stories (swap, don't reword); vaccine/antibiotic design for treatment is fine. Fetch tips: JAMA RSS dates are issue dates (verify via Crossref); Korean feeds are KST without offset; prefer outlet RSS over site: search for recency.
